You're prepping backlog-refinement notes for a Salesforce PWA Kit storefront (Zimmermann) FED Lead, for Jira ticket SFCC-279 "Cart Persistence Configuration". Read-only research — you are not writing to Jira or Confluence.

SHARED GROUND TRUTH (cite, don't re-derive):
- Today is 2026-09-03. Real Sprint 4 runs 2026-08-24–2026-09-07 (active now); Sprint 5 runs 2026-09-07–2026-09-21. The repo's .docs/memory/sprintScope.md is CONFIRMED STALE — judge this ticket on its own Jira status/fields.
- Cart PRD (.docs/prd/cart.md) §3 (CAI-014/015, CRM-170): guest cart persisted 30 days, logged-in cart persisted indefinitely, separate bag per storefront (a customer's AU bag and US bag are independent).
- The word "Configuration" in the title, combined with this being persistence/TTL behaviour, suggests this may be largely a SFCC Business Manager settings/config story rather than one with real PWA component surface — e.g. consuming an existing basket-expiry setting rather than building new UI. Don't assume this though — check the ticket's actual AC to confirm or correct this reading. This should land squarely on sizing-lens question 1 (is there FE impact at all) and question 6 (pure FE vs shared FE/BE vs architecture) — answer both directly and honestly rather than defaulting to "yes there's FE work" out of habit.
- A separate ticket in this batch, SFCC-649 "Cart Guest to Authenticated Basket Merge on Sign In", covers the login-merge behaviour specifically — check this ticket doesn't overlap with that one; persistence/TTL configuration and merge-on-login are related but distinct concerns per the PRD's own section numbering (CAI-014/015 vs CFD-006).

DO THIS:
1. Fetch the full ticket: jira_get_issue(issue_key='SFCC-279', fields='summary,description,status,issuelinks,comment,attachment,parent', comment_limit=20).
2. Fetch SFCC-649 (description only is fine) for the overlap check.
3. Apply the seven-point sizing lens: (1) any FE impact — be honest if the answer is "little to none"? (2) is the requirement clear enough to size? (3) which surfaces does it touch (SFCC Business Manager config vs. PWA code — say which)? (4) design/Figma dependencies (likely none — say so if true)? (5) API/backend dependencies? (6) pure FE, shared FE/BE, or needs architecture input — this is the central question for this ticket? (7) size now, or need clarification first?
4. Read for the four standing axes: behaviour, desktop/mobile (likely not applicable — say so if true), a11y (likely not applicable), data (is there any PWA-side code that reads/respects the TTL, e.g. showing a "your bag will expire" notice, or is this entirely invisible to the frontend?) — flag anything genuinely unclear.
5. Design dependency: does a design exist, or is "N/A" the honest answer?
6. Altitude: BAs own component-decomposition questions, devs own atomic/build questions.

OUTPUT, in this exact shape:
- One-line plain-language summary
- Seven lens answers
- Four axes, flagging what's unclear (or explicitly marking axes N/A where genuinely not applicable)
- Design status + source (or N/A)
- The overlap check against SFCC-649
- Specific questions to raise, each tagged with who should answer it
- One-line readiness call

Be concrete, don't editorialize past what the data supports, and say plainly what you couldn't check.

1	# PRD – Cart & Inventory
2	
3	*Source of truth: Zimmermann Functional Requirements.xlsx, sheets "Cart & Inventory" and "Order Management". Last updated: 2026-06-19.*
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 1. Mini-Cart (CAI-001 – CAI-005)
8	
9	- Opens as an overlay on Add to Bag CTA or bag icon click (CAI-001)
10	- Per line item: product image, name, colour, price (was/now if on sale), size, quantity, item total (CAI-001, CAI-006)
11	- Actions per line item: Move to Wishlist, Remove (CAI-004)
12	- **Move to Wishlist is authenticated-only at launch** — only logged-in customers can move a mini-cart item to wishlist; an unauthenticated user selecting Move to Wishlist is prompted to log in first (CAI-004). Guest wishlist capability is a logged enhancement, not in scope for go-live — see Section 4.
13	- Subtotal (incl/excl tax per storefront) with Checkout CTA navigating to checkout entry (CAI-002), and View Bag link to full cart page (CAI-003)
14	- **"Recommended for You" carousel** beneath bag contents — recommendation engine platform TBC (SFCC Einstein vs Athos Commerce), see Open Items (CAI-005)
15	- No recommendations in checkout or order summary — mini-cart and cart only (CFD-021)
16	- International customers (as determined by selected shipping country): Checkout CTA redirects to Global-e checkout
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 2. Cart Page (CAI-006 – CAI-017)
21	
22	- Per line item: image, name, colour, size, price (was/now), quantity controls (increment/decrement — CAI-007), item total
23	- Actions per line item: Remove, Move to Wishlist (CAI-008)
24	- **Move to Wishlist is authenticated-only at launch** — only logged-in customers can move a cart item to wishlist; an unauthenticated user selecting Move to Wishlist is prompted to log in first (CAI-008). Guest wishlist capability is a logged enhancement, not in scope for go-live — see Section 4.
25	- Order summary: item count, subtotal (incl/excl tax per storefront), shipping (TBC at checkout), tax where applicable, grand total in local currency (CAI-009)
26	- Promo code field (CAI-011) and Checkout CTA (CAI-010)
27	- Empty cart message shown when cart is empty (CAI-012)
28	- **Max 3 units per SKU** (same size + colour) per order — error displayed if exceeded (CAI-017)
29	- Price changes while item is in cart are automatically reflected; no customer notification required (CAI-016)
30	- Sale pricing (was/now) displayed consistently across mini-cart and cart page (CAI-013)
31	
32	---
33	
34	## 3. Cart Persistence (CAI-014 – CAI-015)
35	
36	- **Guest cart:** persisted for **30 days**
37	- **Logged-in cart:** persisted **indefinitely**
38	- **Cart merge on login:** if a guest adds items and then logs in during checkout, carts are merged (CFD-006)
39	- **Separate bag per storefront** — a customer's AU bag and US bag are independent (CRM-170)
40	
41	---
42	
43	## 4. Wishlist (CAI-018, CRM)
44	
45	- Wishlist requires authentication — guests attempting to save are redirected to login (CAI-018)
46	- **Size-level** wishlist; single global wishlist; one size per product
47	- 18-month inactivity cleanup
48	- Shareable via email
49	- Back-in-stock notifications from wishlist items
50	- Guest wishlist (with merge on login) is **out of scope for go-live** — captured in the enhancement log (CAI-018, ENH-039)
51	- **Wishlist hosting platform (SFCC vs Omneo) is being sized, not confirmed** — see Open Items (ENH-038/039). The Move-to-Wishlist login-prompt behaviour (CAI-004/008) is independent of where the wishlist is ultimately stored.
52	
53	---
54	
55	## 5. Inventory Display (CAI-024 – CAI-031, OM-021 – OM-032)
56	
57	### Feeds
58	- Daily full inventory feed from NewStore via MuleSoft (CAI-019)
59	- Delta feed via MuleSoft every **15 minutes** (confirmed — CAI-020)
60	- All inventory calls routed through MuleSoft — never SFCC directly to NewStore (CAI-022)
61	- Mulesoft delivers a combined available-to-promise figure aggregating warehouse and eligible boutique stock per region; this aggregate drives browse-level availability states (Add to Bag / Back Soon / Out of Stock) (CAI-023). MuleSoft's ability to perform this aggregation is unconfirmed — see Open Items.
62	
63	### Buffer stock
64	- Configurable buffer threshold **per SKU per storefront** in SFCC Business Manager (CAI-024, CAI-025). Applied at SFCC level, not in the feed itself.
65	- Category-level fallback retained; SKU-level takes precedence; thresholds are **not additive**.
66	- Business users can set buffer stock via bulk upload (by category, colour, store view).
67	- **ADD TO BAG** shown when variant stock exceeds buffer threshold (CAI-026)
68	- **OUT OF STOCK** shown when stock is above zero but at or below buffer threshold; Add to Bag disabled and back-in-stock capture presented (CAI-027)
69	- **OUT OF STOCK** also shown when variant stock is fully depleted; same disabled state and back-in-stock capture (CAI-028)
70	- Low-stock indicator shown at size level — **no quantity number displayed**; not displayed in mini-cart or cart (CAI-030)
71	- Business users can suppress OOS products from PLP (CAI-031)
72	
73	### General availability vs. boutique stock
74	- General browsing uses a combined (buffered) stock figure
75	- Boutique inventory: real-time call to NewStore via MuleSoft, **no buffer applied**, only triggered when Find in Boutique flyout panel or BOPIS boutique selection screen is opened
76	
77	---
78	
79	## 6. Reservation (CAI-032 – CAI-036)
80	
81	- **No soft reservation** at add-to-cart
82	- **Hard reservation** only at order placement
83	- Real-time inventory check via NewStore/MuleSoft when customer proceeds from cart → checkout entry; desired behaviour confirmed, but a new MuleSoft flow is required as none currently exists — see Open Items (CAI-034)
84	- If an item is OOS at checkout entry: Checkout CTA is disabled; customer must remove the item. No auto-removal (CAI-035/036)
85	- Cart notifies customer when an item becomes OOS while in cart (CAI-035)
86	
87	---
88	
89	## 7. Find in Boutique (CAI-037 – CAI-042)
90	
91	- Button shown on PDP for eligible products
92	- Opens as a flyout panel (CAI-037)
93	- On open: real-time call to NewStore via MuleSoft once a size has been selected (the call is per-size and refreshes when the customer selects a different size — CAI-038)
94	- No auto-refresh while the flyout panel is open
95	- Per-boutique availability for the currently selected size: **In Stock / Low Stock – Contact Boutique to Confirm Availability / Out of Stock** (CAI-039)
96	- **No buffer stock** applied to boutique inventory; true physical NewStore OMS stock levels are displayed (CAI-040)
97	- Boutique stock cached with a configurable TTL (set in Business Manager — CAI-042)
98	- Display a clear message when no boutiques carry the selected size (CAI-041)
99	- *Open item: location-aware fallback (serve inventory from a nearby boutique based on user location) flagged as a potential post-launch enhancement (CAI-041, to discuss)*
100	
101	---
102	
103	## 8. Collect in Boutique / BOPIS (CAI-043 – CAI-045)
104	
105	*Scope: UK, AU, EU domestic storefronts only.*
106	
107	- Real-time call to NewStore OMS via MuleSoft when the customer selects Collect in Boutique, validating both store eligibility and stock availability for the selected item and size (CAI-043)
108	- On order placement, the order is submitted to NewStore OMS with the selected boutique as the fulfilment location; NewStore routes and assigns to boutique staff (CAI-044)
109	- Collect in Boutique availability responses cached on initial OMS call, refreshed on TTL expiry; TTL configurable in Business Manager (CAI-045)
110	
111	---
112	
113	## 9. Exclusive / VIP Products (CAI-046 – CAI-047, CRM-162 – CRM-164)
114	
115	- Exclusive/VIP items are **visible only to eligible customer groups**; customer group membership is managed via Omneo and configured in SFCC Business Manager (CAI-046)
116	- Ineligible customers cannot see these items in search or PLP (CAI-047)
117	- A **private marketing URL** grants access to exclusive VIC products without requiring login or customer group assignment at browse time — but purchase is still restricted to the eligible group (CRM-162)
118	- **VIC Exclusive tag** displayed on PLP tile and PDP for eligible customers
119	
120	---
121	
122	## 10. Back-in-Stock Notifications (OM-033 – OM-034)
123	
124	- Customer captures email on OOS product; the notify-me email and product details are submitted to **Emarsys** (CAI-029)
125	- Back-in-stock email sent to the first configurable-N customers on a FIFO basis when stock returns above buffer
126	- **No loyalty tier prioritisation** — strictly FIFO
127	- Guest capture timing is subject to the Omneo guest record creation open item (see AGENTS.md "Unresolved Dependencies")
128	
129	---
130	
131	## 11. No-Split Orders (CFD-033, CAI-033)
132	
133	- No order splitting — all items in an order are delivered to the same address
134	- Customer is informed post-purchase if items ship in multiple parcels (via Narvar)
135	
136	---
137	
138	## 12. Open Items
139	
140	- **CAI-005 — Recommendation engine for mini-cart carousel not confirmed.** The requirement text now reads "powered by SFCC Einstein (or Athos Commerce pending search platform decision)", but the row's open comment "Search / reccomendation engine not confirmed" persists and RJ adds "It is 99% likely we will move away from Athos". Treat platform (Einstein vs Athos Commerce) as undecided. **FLAG — cross-sheet contradiction:** Third_Party_Integrations (Search and Recommendations / Salesforce Einstein) states the system "will use Salesforce Einstein for all search, merchandising and product recommendation functionality across all storefronts," which contradicts CAI-005 treating the engine as unconfirmed. Do not silently resolve — confirm with Zimmermann which sheet is authoritative.
141	- **CAI-023 — MuleSoft warehouse + boutique aggregation feasibility.** IC: "We had a requirement that for a SKU/size to be considered 'in stock' then it would take into account an aggregated view of warehouse & boutique stock... Will Mulesoft be able to do this?" SFCC OOTB does not aggregate; aggregation capability pending confirmation.
142	- **CAI-034 — Real-time cart→checkout inventory check requires new MuleSoft flow.** "Currently the Mulesoft does not exists for this, and will require a new MuleSoft flow. Otherwise, we will just use inventory feed." Behaviour desired/confirmed, build dependency open.
143	- **CAI-041 — Location-aware boutique fallback.** RJ: "We need to consider the users location and we could potentially serve inventory from a nearby boutique." Potential post-launch enhancement.
144	- **CAI-037/039 — Find in Boutique design marked Phase 2.** Requirement Confirmed; designs not yet available for go-live timing.
145	- **ENH-038 / ENH-039 — SFCC-hosted wishlist being scoped (not confirmed).** Previously out of scope (wishlist to migrate to Omneo); both enhancements now flipped — ENH-038 (add OOS products to wishlist from PLP) Zimm response: *"ACN to size — wishlist in SFCC"*; ENH-039 (guest wishlist consolidating on login) Zimm response: *"ACN to size"* / *"To be sized"*. A SFCC-hosted wishlist for go-live is being sized but not confirmed. The Move-to-Wishlist behaviour (CAI-004/008) depends on whether the wishlist ultimately lives in SFCC vs Omneo (cf. ENH-040, which logs the SFCC→Omneo migration as a separate enhancement). Both still status "Under Review" — confirm hosting platform and go-live scope with Zimmermann before build.

41-
42-- **Single SDK.** `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` handles every SFCC call — SLAS token lifecycle, retry, and TanStack Query caching.
43-- **SSR and CSR.** Catalogue, PDP, PLP, content, and boutique pages are server-rendered for SEO and LCP. Cart, checkout, My Account, and order pages render an SSR shell and hydrate personalised data client-side after auth.
--
49-- **Refresh tokens live in `httpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict` cookies** set by the SSR layer. Browser JavaScript never sees the raw refresh token. On each refresh SLAS regenerates the token and voids the old one; the SSR layer rewrites the cookie in the same response.
50-- **Private client credentials.** The SLAS client secret is an MRT environment variable and never reaches the browser. The authorisation code exchange goes through the MRT private-client proxy (`privateClientProxyEndpoint`). The SLAS client ID and SCAPI short code stay in the bundle as public identifiers.
51-- **Social login.** Apple and Google via SLAS third-party identity-provider federation — confirmed in scope for launch; implementation design still open.
52:- **No Open Commerce API (OCAPI) credentials in the browser.** Any operation not yet covered by SCAPI is proxied through Managed Runtime with OCAPI credentials held server-side.
53-
54-### Magento password migration (CFD-013)
55-
56-Passwords were not migrated from Magento. All existing customers must reset at go-live. Failed sign-ins return a generic "invalid credentials" message (no email-existence leak) and the "forgot password" link is always visible.
57-
58-### Cross-storefront session continuity
59-
60-All eight storefronts are path-prefixed on a single domain and share one SFCC realm.
61-
62-- **The refresh-token cookie is shared across storefronts.** Every storefront lives on the same domain, so the `httpOnly` cookie is sent on every path prefix. No cross-domain SSO bridge is needed.

New site ID `ZimmermannUSIntl` pending BM confirmation.

106	- Gift card PDP, cart, checkout, and GiveX integration
107	- Promotions engine and multi-currency/FX pricebook setup
108	- CI workflow split — two complementary workflows, each with a clear role:
109	  - `qa.yml` (every PR to `develop`/`release/**`): `unit-tests` (Vitest) + `storybook-test` (Storybook `play` + `@storybook/addon-a11y`, `storybook test --ci`) run in parallel; `e2e-browserstack` on release PRs only. **`storybook-test` job is wired but pending `@storybook/addon-test` and `@storybook/addon-a11y` installation (feature/storybook-v10 upgrade task).**
110	  - `digital-sit.yml` (push/PR to `release/**`): four parallel jobs into `sit-gate` — `playwright-p0` (Chromium P0 suite), `bundle-size` (bundlewatch, main.js < 180 kB / vendor.js < 250 kB / main.css < 50 kB), `contract-tests` (placeholder; real MuleSoft OpenAPI assertion pending spec source), `lighthouse-ci` (Perf ≥ 80, A11y ≥ 90, Best Practices ≥ 90; requires LHCI server secrets)
111	- **`e2e-localhost` (qa.yml) is fixed and re-enabled, as of PR #35 (`bugfix/ci-e2e-test`, merged 2026-07-16).** Root cause of the "homepage smoke test fails in CI, logo never found" issue (open as of PR #30): `BasePage.js`'s old `dismissConsent()` wrapped both `waitFor()` and `.click()` in one `try/catch`, so a real click failure was silently swallowed as "no dialog appeared" — if a consent dialog genuinely appeared in CI (injected by something outside this repo's own source, e.g. GTM/MRT platform config — not by anything grep-visible in `overrides/`) and the click failed transiently, the `aria-modal` dialog stayed open and blocked the entire page's accessibility tree, exactly matching the symptom. Fixed by CodeRabbit-prompted review in PR #30 (separated `.click()` out of the `try/catch`) — but that fix was never actually exercised in CI until PR #35 re-enabled the job, confirmed via 4 consecutive clean CI passes. Along the way also: added an HTML reporter to `playwright.config.js` (every project except `p0` had been silently producing an empty `playwright-report/` — CI failures were undebuggable from artifacts alone); fixed a webpack-build-race (`wait-on` only confirms the port is open, not that the client bundle finished compiling — added a step polling `dev-server.log` for `webpack built client`); fixed the original missing-Commerce-API-env-vars bug (job now binds `environment: dev`, sources `COMMERCE_API_*` from `vars.*`, `scripts/switchEnv.mjs`'s `push <tier>` uploads a shared+tier merge so one environment binding is self-sufficient); switched the job gate from `always()` to `!cancelled()` so a superseded/cancelled run doesn't burn a 15-min runner slot.
112	- PR #30 (`feature/gh-qa-workflow`, merged) also: deleted the unfinished `SFCC-000_guest-checkout` placeholder (never had real Adyen payment interaction, self-described `EXAMPLE` in its own header) and its `testIgnore` mis-scoping (ran under `chromium`/`mobile-chrome` `retries:2` instead of the dedicated `p0` project's `retries:0`, costing ~12 of the ~14 min `e2e-localhost` runtime on every PR); added a homepage smoke test (new `homepage` E2E area + `SMOKE-` naming convention for Jira-less tests); fixed a `@typescript-eslint/no-var-requires` misconfiguration flagging `require()` in `e2e/`'s intentionally-CommonJS files; added `test-results/`/`playwright-report/` to `.gitignore`.
113	- **Proposed: tag-based environment promotion (GitFlow) — full spec on Confluence, implementation not yet started.** Full rationale, tag naming convention, worked commands, and open questions:
114	  [Proposed: Tag-Based Environment Promotion (GitFlow)](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/335216656/Proposed+Tag-Based+Environment+Promotion+GitFlow)
115	  (Confluence, v5, child of the Branching Guide page). Summary: only `Dev` should be continuously tied to `develop`; every other tier should deploy a specific, immutable git tag (`vX.Y.Z-rc.N` / `vX.Y.Z` / `vX.Y.Z-hotfix.N`, cut via `npm version`) instead of a branch ref, so Test/SIT/UAT/Stage can each run independent testing cycles instead of being forced onto the same moving branch. **Do not implement the AGENTS.md/governance pieces without squad-lead + Integration-lead sign-off — this is still a proposal.** Implementation checklist for a fresh session on a new branch (see the Confluence page for full detail on each item):
116	  - **Decided 2026-07-16** (see Confluence page's "Decisions made so far" table): release cadence is per-sprint; pre-launch versioning starts at `v0.1.0` (MAJOR locked at `0` until go-live, which becomes `v1.0.0`); `Test` gets its own automated CI gate (not manual-only); tag protection + the version-guard + Release-per-final-tag are all adopted immediately, not phased in.
117	  - **Tooling — safe to build now, doesn't touch governance docs:**
118	    1. `npm version` adoption — no code change needed, it's a built-in npm command; just start using it per the Confluence page's "How to deploy" section instead of raw `git tag`. First tag will be `v0.1.0-rc.0`.
119	    2. **Primary enforcement — one GitHub Ruleset covers both naming and immutability:** Settings → Rules → Rulesets → New tag ruleset, targeting `v*`, with a "tag name pattern" rule requiring `^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-rc\.\d+|-hotfix\.\d+)?$` plus "restrict creation," "restrict updates," and "restrict deletion" all enabled. This genuinely hard-blocks a non-matching tag at push time *and* prevents force-push/delete on matching tags — all on GitHub.com, not Enterprise Server-only (corrected from an earlier draft of this note, which wrongly split this into a separate "tag protection rules" step and claimed pattern-blocking wasn't possible on GitHub.com). Keep a `push: tags: ['*']` validation workflow too, as defense-in-depth / for a clearer failure message than the raw ruleset rejection gives.
120	    3. A version-guard step added to each `deploy-*.yml` (test/sit/stg/uat/prod) — fetch the environment's current deployed tag via `gh api repos/ZimmermannAU/zimmermann-pwa/deployments?environment=<env>`, semver-compare against the tag being deployed (use the `semver` npm package, not hand-rolled bash comparison — pre-release identifiers must be dot-separated, e.g. `-rc.10` vs `-rc.2`, or numeric comparison breaks), fail on a downgrade. **`<env>` must be the actual GitHub Environment name, not the workflow-file suffix** — they diverge for `stg` (`deploy-stg.yml` targets the `staging` Environment, not `stg`; we hit this exact mismatch once already this session, commit `12bf91b`). Map each tier explicitly (`stg` → `staging`, everything else matches its filename) rather than deriving it from the filename. Fail closed if the environment name is wrong or the API call errors — a genuine first-ever deployment (no prior Deployment record at all) is fine to proceed, but an unresolvable environment/API error is not the same thing and must not be treated as "nothing to compare against, allow it."
121	    4. **A Test-tier CI gate** — new, decided 2026-07-16. Proposed shape (not yet confirmed, see the page's remaining two open questions): a second job appended to `deploy-test.yml` that runs a P0-only Playwright suite against whatever was just deployed, so the run's pass/fail becomes the "safe to promote to SIT" signal — deliberately deploy-then-gate rather than SIT Gate's gate-then-deploy, since `Test` is on-demand (`workflow_dispatch`, including raw feature branches) and has no push/PR event to hang a pre-check on.
122	    5. Wire `/generate-changelog`'s existing `gh release create` offer into the "cut the final tag" step — no new tooling, the skill already does this.
123	  - **Governance — needs squad-lead + Integration-lead review before merging:**
124	    6. A new `.claude/rules/tagging.md` (or fold into `.docs/releaseBranchesRules.md`, already auto-loaded on `release/*`/`hotfix/*`) documenting the tag convention and instructing Claude to always use `npm version`, never hand-construct a tag string.
125	    7. `AGENTS.md`'s branch table / the Confluence Branching Guide itself, once the team has actually reviewed and approved the proposal — this repo's `AGENTS.md` requires both squad leads and the Integration lead to sign off on changes to itself, stronger than the usual verified-session Tier 1 exception.
126	  - Still open per the Confluence page: exact Test-gate design (deploy-then-gate as proposed, or match SIT's gate-then-deploy exactly) and its scope (P0 suite only, or also bundle-size/contract-tests/Lighthouse).
127	
128	## Unresolved Dependencies
129	Do not hard-code assumptions for the following — ask the user before implementing:
130	- Product copy ownership: Contentful vs SFCC vs AP21 (TBD).
131	- Translation trigger workflow with TransPerfect (TBD).
132	- Global-e + Didomi consent interaction (TBD).
133	- **Social login (Apple/Google):** Confirmed in scope for launch (ENH-004, Must-Have, Go-Live) as SFCC OOTB configuration only. **Hard dependency:** Apple and Google merchant accounts must be provisioned by Zimmermann before implementation can start. Do not implement until merchant accounts exist.
134	- **Omneo guest record creation timing:** When to create an Omneo record for a guest (at newsletter sign-up, at back-in-stock capture, at checkout, or only at order completion) is under legal/SFCC best-practice review. SFCC best practice is order completion only. Do not create Omneo records for guests at any earlier point until confirmed. Note: CRM-012–015 are signed off but Tony Tilbrook (early creation) and Izzy Coxon (order-completion only) currently disagree on the timing — treat as Open until reconciled.
135	- **Denmark routing:** Which storefront Denmark resolves to is not yet confirmed.
136	- **EU billing fields:** Locale-specific billing fields (Italian Codice Fiscale, Spanish NIF, French SIRET) — to be confirmed before implementing.
137	- **Adyen dynamic checkout (ENH-020):** Confirmed Must-Have for Go-Live, but a **hard dependency on Adyen** delivering A/B-able dynamic payment-method display. Do not assume the feature is buildable end-to-end until Adyen delivery is confirmed.
138	- **Optimizely SFCC data-layer scope (AAB-004):** Load mechanism Confirmed (PWA-direct head tag, US-only, Zimmermann-provided script). Residual: Tell No Lies suspects no SFCC-side data-layer work is needed for Optimizely (Magento launch was GTM-only). content.text:
## SFCC-279 — Backlog Refinement Notes (Cart Persistence Configuration)

**Ground truth used:** Today 2026-09-03, Sprint 4 active (2026-08-24–09-07), Sprint 5 next (09-07–09-21); `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md` is stale, ignored in favour of live Jira status. PRD: `.docs/prd/cart.md` §3 (CAI-014/015, CRM-170). Cross-check ticket: SFCC-649.

**Note on the ticket title:** the real Jira summary is more specific than the batch label — **"Cart Behaviour – Cart Persistence Configuration (Guest 30 Days, Authenticated 6 Months)"** — and that parenthetical number is itself the headline finding below. Status: **Tech design** (To Do), parent epic SFCC-11 "Cart" (To Do). No issue links, no attachments returned.

---

### One-line summary
A Business Manager-only config story to set guest-cart retention to 30 days and authenticated-cart retention to 6 months (timer resets on every basket interaction) — but the "6 months" figure, confirmed in a Jira comment, contradicts the PRD's "indefinitely" for logged-in carts, and that conflict needs resolving before the value is locked in.

### Seven-point sizing lens
1. **Any FE impact?** Confirmed little-to-none — not inferred. The ticket's own description states outright: "This is a Business Manager configuration story — not a frontend build." Independently verified: no code anywhere in `overrides/` or `config/` touches basket TTL/expiry (grep swept both; the few incidental hits were false positives — `settled`/`settles` matching the `ttl` substring — see Data axis).
2. **Clear enough to size?** Mostly, with one real gap. Guest duration (30 days) is consistent between PRD and Jira. **Authenticated duration is not**: PRD `cart.md` §3 says "persisted indefinitely" (CAI-014/015); Jira's confirmed value (comment, 2026-08-07: "Confirmed 6 months cart persistance for authenticated") is 6 months. The reset-on-interaction rule is unambiguous and well-written in the AC. A second open item on the ticket (discontinued-product-in-cart scenario) was explicitly forked to SFCC-796 (confirmed — see below), so that's resolved, not a residual gap.
3. **Surfaces touched?** SFCC Business Manager config only. Per a 2026-08-04 comment from Isabel Chaloner, this is native OOTB SFCC capability (site preference for guest/registered basket lifetime, max 999 days). No PWA code path identified anywhere.
4. **Design/Figma dependencies?** None — ticket explicitly states "No designs required," and no Figma link/attachment is present (contrast with sibling SFCC-796, which does carry one for its own, different UI-facing scope).
5. **API/backend dependencies?** None beyond the BM setting itself — described as native SFCC platform behaviour, not a custom API or MuleSoft/Omneo integration build.
6. **Pure FE / shared FE-BE / architecture input?** None of the three in the usual sense — this is pure platform configuration with zero code build on either side, and no architecture decision is implicated. The only open decision is a business/requirements one (which number is right), not a technical one.
7. **Size now or clarify first?** Sizeable now — effort is the same trivial class of BM change regardless of which number wins. Flag the PRD/Jira conflict as a pre-**work** gate (must be settled before an implementer sets the value), not a pre-**sizing** blocker.

### Four standing axes
- **Behaviour:** Reasonably well defined — timer resets on add/remove/update/open, guest = 30 days, authenticated = 6 months per Jira (vs. PRD's "indefinite" — see conflict above). The discontinued-product edge case is explicitly out of this ticket's scope, forked to SFCC-796.
- **Desktop/mobile:** N/A, confirmed — no UI or component involved anywhere in this story.
- **A11y:** N/A, confirmed — same reasoning.
- **Data:** As far as could be verified, entirely invisible to the frontend. No PWA code, no UI copy, and no PRD requirement anywhere (Mini-Cart or Cart Page sections) calls for a "your bag will expire" notice or any client-side read of the TTL. One adjacent-but-unrelated term exists in `.docs/vendor/global-e.md` ("session expiry" as a Global-e basket-creation failure mode) — that's a distinct concept (Global-e checkout session) from this SFCC-native basket-persistence config, not a hit against this ticket.

### Design status
**N/A** — ticket text states "No designs required"; no Figma reference or attachment on the issue.

### Overlap check vs. SFCC-649
No overlap — cleanly separated by PRD section. SFCC-279 covers persistence/TTL **duration** only (CAI-014/015). SFCC-649 ("Cart – Guest to Authenticated Basket Merge on Sign-In") covers what happens to the two baskets **at the moment of login** (CFD-006), and explicitly excludes max-quantity-on-merge enforcement (pushed to SFCC-250). Neither ticket's description references the other's mechanism.

### Questions to raise
1. **[BA/PM — PRD owner]** Reconcile the authenticated-cart duration conflict: PRD `.docs/prd/cart.md` §3 (CAI-014/015) says "indefinitely"; Jira SFCC-279 confirms "6 months" (comment, 2026-08-07, post-dating the PRD's 2026-06-19 last-update). Which is correct, and should the PRD be updated to match?
2. **[BA]** One-line confirmation at refinement that SFCC-279 carries no residual AC for the "product discontinued while in cart" scenario — the comment thread already redirects it to SFCC-796, just worth confirming out loud so it isn't silently dropped.
3. **[Dev/Integration]** Confirm whether the BM basket-lifetime preference is a single instance-wide setting or must be configured per site — relevant given CRM-170's "separate bag per storefront" across all 8 storefronts; affects whether this is a one-time config or eight repetitions of it.

### Readiness call
Ready to size now as a small, config-only story — but raise the PRD-vs-Jira "6 months vs. indefinite" conflict in the room before anyone locks in the actual BM value.

---

**Could not check / out of the requested scope:** Confluence (not in the fetch list for this task); the ticket's sprint/board field (only core fields were pulled, so I can't say whether it's slated for Sprint 4 tail-end or Sprint 5); SFCC-250's own detail (only referenced via SFCC-649's text, not fetched directly — not needed for the SFCC-279/649 overlap check).
